challenge: DEV Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 1 (Touch Grass)

prize_focus.primary: Best Use of Sentry Agent Tracing ($100)
prize_focus.note: One win per submission per challenge. If gate 4 fails, Mastra becomes primary and Sentry is dropped.

workflow_rules: One phase per chat. One JSON task prompt at a time.
Mohan verifies by screenshot or real run before the next task.
Never trust agent self-reports. Run it yourself.
Gemini Flash by default. Escalate to Claude Sonnet after two failed attempts.
Send any failed gate output to Claude in chat before continuing.
gates: GATE 2 (T2.1): writer under 45 s with verifier catching planted fact
GATE 3 (T2.2): Mastra workflow runs end to end
